title: T2I-BiasBench: A Multi-Metric Framework for Auditing Demographic and Cultural Bias in Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting gender attributes (male, female, unknown) from VLM-generated captions of images produced for professional prompts (e.g., 'Doctor') and calculating representation parity, parity difference, and bias amplification.

Extracting explicit ethnicity categories from VLM-generated captions of images produced for underspecified prompts (e.g., 'Beauty') and measuring statistical divergence (KL divergence, Shannon entropy) from a uniform fairness reference.
Classifying generated subjects into skin tone levels (Fair, Medium, Dark) using VLM captions and evaluating distributional skew and bias amplification against a uniform reference distribution.

Measuring cultural representation collapse for region-specific prompts (e.g., Indian festivals) by extracting cultural markers and calculating a Cultural Accuracy Ratio (CAR) and Contextual Association Score (CAS) to evaluate cultural breadth versus stereotyping.
